# JMeter Sample Fixtures

Place sample JMeter result files here for use in integration and unit tests.

## Expected files

| Filename | Format | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `small.csv` | JMeter CSV | 100-row minimal CSV sample |
| `small.jtl` | JMeter JTL/XML | 100-row minimal XML sample |
| `large.csv` | JMeter CSV | 100 000-row stress-test sample (gitignored) |
